body.statement: As a classical corollary of the graphic-matroid union theorem in \cite{Edmonds1965}, \(r_q(E)=\min_{F\subseteq E}\{|E\setminus F|+q(|V|-c(F))\}\). Applied after the attainable-row theorem and the tree-packing criterion of \cite{NashWilliams1961}, its disjoint-forest and minimizing-set outputs certify whether the causal operator can generically attain rank \(q(|V|-1)\); no new combinatorial min--max theorem is claimed.
body.justification: The cited classical certificate makes the new causal rank conclusion auditable without treating the certificate itself as a contribution.
body.gap: The min--max identity is classical; the only project-specific content is that Theorem 6 makes it a certificate for attainable proximal-network rank.
body.consumer: Evidence-network curators can attach a short classical certificate to the causal conclusion that a proposed graph does or does not exhaust its proxy-limited information.
